About

Where an economics degree meets a spreadsheet.

I bring a slightly different lens to data analysis: an economics degree from Alexandria University's Faculty of Economic Studies & Political Science trained me to ask why a number moved before I ever touch a chart. That instinct now drives every dashboard I build.

My hands-on foundation comes from the Digital Egypt Pioneers Initiative (DEPI)'s Professional Data Analyst Track, under Egypt's Ministry of Communications and Information Technology — an intensive, practice-heavy program built around Python, Advanced SQL, Power BI (Power Query, DAX, data modeling), and Tableau. I apply all of it to real retail datasets, not toy examples. I care about the boring-but-critical part of analytics: clean pipelines, correct joins, features that actually mean something. Then I translate it into something a non-technical stakeholder can act on in five minutes.

When I'm not in a notebook, I'm sharpening how I communicate data — because an insight nobody understands isn't an insight.

Featured Project

Superstore Executive Sales & Profit Dashboard

An end-to-end exploratory analysis and automated reporting project built during the DEPI Professional Data Analyst Track — turning 9,993+ raw retail transactions into a single, publication-ready 3×3 executive dashboard.

$2M+Revenue in "High" tier
-0.864Discount–margin correlation
41.2%West region return rate
9,993+Transactions processed

The Problem

A multinational retailer had transaction-level data but no clear view of where sales were profitable, where discounting was destroying margin, or which regions were bleeding revenue through returns.

The Approach

  • Cleaned & unified 9,993+ records — missing postal codes, duplicates, mismatched product IDs.
  • Engineered Shipping_Duration, Profit_Margin, Is_Loss, and a quantile-based Sales Performance Category.
  • Answered 15 core business questions across segmentation, region, logistics, and returns.
  • Consolidated 9 visualizations into one executive-ready grid.

Key Insights

  • The "High" performance tier drives outsized revenue and profit — a Pareto-style concentration of value.
  • Discounts above 20% consistently push orders into financial loss.
  • West region flagged for urgent review due to its return rate, concentrated in Consumer Technology.

Retail Data Warehouse — Star Schema Design

Designed and built a dimensional data warehouse for retail sales data — modeling a central fact table against customer, product, order, ship-mode, location, and date dimensions. The star-schema structure keeps reporting fast and consistent, so BI dashboards can pull reliable metrics without repeating complex joins.

RFM Customer Segmentation — Deep Dive

Segmented customers by Recency, Frequency, and Monetary value, then cross-tabulated average spend across every score combination to reveal exactly which behavioral profiles drive the most revenue.
